aura_system.principle: AURA uses the SAME typographic architecture as GlowApp. No third font family. AURA expresses through: Manrope (functional) + Aura Teal color + distinctive spacing/hierarchy. Cormorant only when editorial context exists (storytelling, results explanation).

aura_metadata.name: AURA Metadata
aura_metadata.purpose: AURA confidence scores, analysis IDs, technical metadata

concierge_message.name: Concierge Message
concierge_message.purpose: Conversational AI messages — slightly more generous line height for readability

women_system.principle: Women expression emphasizes EDITORIAL VOICE (Cormorant Garamond) in brand moments. Functional UI remains Manrope. No separate 'WomenFont'.

editorial_emphasis.rationale: Editorial warmth aligns with Women beauty editorial aesthetic

men_system.principle: Men expression uses SAME two-voice architecture. Differentiation through color, photography, composition, spacing, iconography — NOT font family changes.

editorial_voice.styling: Slightly tighter tracking, darker color (warm white on obsidian), same scale

functional_voice.styling: Identical scale, weight, line height as Women. Color: warm white on dark surfaces.

men_system.quiet_masculine_luxury: Achieved through: obsidian surfaces, warm white text, champagne/copper accents, generous spacing, restrained editorial moments — not through font changes.

concierge_system.principle: PERSONAL, PREMIUM, HUMAN — not call center, not corporate software.

concierge_display.name: Concierge Display
concierge_display.purpose: Concierge welcome, personal greetings, ritual introductions

concierge_body.name: Concierge Body
concierge_body.purpose: Conversational messages, advice, recommendations — slightly larger, more generous line height for personal feel

concierge_label.name: Concierge Label
concierge_label.purpose: Action labels, quick replies, category tags

concierge_action.name: Concierge Action
concierge_action.purpose: Primary CTAs in concierge flow: 'Agendar', 'Ver productos', 'Hablar con experto'

sentence_case.rule: Default for all body, headings, buttons, labels, UI text

title_case.rule: Brand proper nouns, screen titles in navigation, proper names

uppercase.rule: Only for: overline/category labels, badge text, metadata codes, chip labels when space-constrained

prohibited.rule: No ALL CAPS for: body text, button labels (use sentence case), headings, paragraphs, form labels, error messages
prohibited.rationale: Reduces readability, feels aggressive, contradicts QUIET/HUMAN/WARM brand

letter_spacing.principle: Negative for display/headings (optical correction). Positive for small UI labels (legibility). Zero for body. Mono gets positive for tabular alignment.

line_height.principle: Display: tight (1.1–1.25) for editorial impact. Body: generous (1.55–1.6) for reading comfort. Concierge: extra generous (1.65–1.7) for conversational warmth. UI: compact (1.3–1.4) for density.

responsive_rules.principle: Fluid hierarchy with controlled scaling. Consistent relationships across breakpoints. No separate systems per breakpoint.

proposed_approach.mobile_base: All sizes defined above are MOBILE base (375px breakpoint)
proposed_approach.tablet_scale: Display +1 to +2 steps, Headings +1 step, Body unchanged, UI unchanged
proposed_approach.desktop_scale: Display +2 to +3 steps, Headings +1 to +2 steps, Body +1 step (16→17), UI +1 step
proposed_approach.note: Exact scaling factors require implementation validation with real content. Documented as REQUIRES IMPLEMENTATION VALIDATION.

contrast.cta_text_on_brand: REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION - depends on final Rose Gold/Champagne values

font_scaling.status: REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION - must test with system font scaling 1.0x, 1.3x, 1.5x, 2.0x

text_overflow.status: REQUIRES_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION - ellipsis, maxLines, flexible layouts needed

localization_impact.spanish_expansion: ~15-20% longer than English. Body line height 1.55 accommodates. Button labels may need flexible width.
localization_impact.numbers_currency: JetBrains Mono tabular figures ensure alignment. COP format: $ 1.234.567 (spaces as thousand separators).

considerations.accents: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope both support full Latin Extended (á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ, ü)
considerations.expansion: Spanish strings ~15-20% longer. Layouts must be flexible. Avoid fixed-width containers for text.
considerations.numbers: COP currency: $ 1.234.567 (space + dots). JetBrains Mono tabular figures recommended.
considerations.direction: LTR only. No RTL considerations currently.
considerations.font_fallback: System UI font stack as fallback if custom fonts fail to load

prohibited_patterns.reason: AURA is intelligence layer, not separate brand. Cyberpunk/tech fonts contradict QUIET/HUMAN/WARM.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: MensTheme.cyberCyan with cyberpunk aesthetic rejected in S1

prohibited_patterns.reason: Men differentiates through color/photography/composition, not font family. Creating 'masculine font' fragments brand.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: Audit shows Men uses same Didot/Inter as Women currently

prohibited_patterns.reason: Serifs reduce legibility at small sizes in dense information (tables, forms, lists, navigation).
prohibited_patterns.evidence: LuxeTypography.bodyMd uses Cormorant at 15px — hard to read in lists

prohibited_patterns.reason: Bold everywhere destroys hierarchy. Reserve 600-700 for labels, buttons, headings. Body stays 400.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: Multiple screens use FontWeight.bold for body text

prohibited_patterns.reason: All caps reduces readability, feels aggressive. Only for labels/badges/metadata with ≥0.5px letter-spacing.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: Settings screen, some provider screens use uppercase for section headers

prohibited_patterns.reason: Every TextStyle must derive from defined scale. No one-off sizes.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: 16+ distinct spacing values in store_screen.dart, similar for font sizes

prohibited_patterns.reason: Creates inconsistency, prevents theming, blocks dark mode, blocks audience adaptation.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: 40+ screens use inline TextStyle with hardcoded fontFamily, size, weight

prohibited_patterns.reason: Declared but unused. Didot currently serves editorial role. Two serif display families unnecessary.
prohibited_patterns.evidence: GlowTokens.fontPlayfairDisplay declared, never used in production code

prohibited_patterns.reason: AppTypography uses generic families — actual mapping happens inline, defeating token purpose.

proposed_authority.rationale: Already used by modern AppTheme (Material 3). Single source for TextTheme. Extensible with real fontFamily mapping.
required_changes: Replace generic 'serif'/'sans'/'monospace' with actual fontFamily strings
Map Cormorant Garamond as display/heading family
Keep JetBrains Mono as mono family
Deprecate Didot, Inter, PlayfairDisplay as transitional aliases
Add dark mode variants that only change color (not family)
Add responsive size variants (mobile/tablet/desktop) when validated

mapping.AppTypography: EXTEND — become single source with real font families
mapping.GlowTokens: REDUCE — keep only fontFamily constants as aliases to AppTypography families. Remove colors.
mapping.GlowStoreTokens: MIGRATE — replace fontEditorialDisplay/Section/ProductName with AppTypography display/heading tokens. Replace fontFunctionalUI with AppTypography body/label tokens. Replace fontPriceDisplay/Metadata with AppTypography price/mono tokens.
mapping.LuxeTypography: DEPRECATE — merge display tokens into AppTypography. Migrate bodyMd (Cormorant 15px) → AppTypography.bodyLarge (Manrope 16px) for readability. Keep monoMd/monoSm → AppTypography mono tokens.
mapping.AppTheme (legacy): ELIMINATE — migrate all screens to AppTheme.of(context) / Token.of(context)

governance.approval_process: Design Director review → Technical feasibility (licensing, file size, variable font support) → Prototype in isolation → Integration to AppTypography → Migration plan → Rollout
governance.font_loading_strategy: preload critical (Manrope, Cormorant Garamond), lazy-load others (JetBrains Mono)
governance.fallback_chain: Manrope → system-ui → sans-serif | Cormorant Garamond → Georgia → serif | JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → monospace
